name: Fujiwara no Hidehira
source:
Hidehira Fujiwara is the third generation owner of Fujiwara Oshu, who is served by the Sato brothers.

A person who accepted and defended Yoshitsune in Hiraizumi. A gentle and encouraging person who wishes for peace in Hiraizumi more than anyone else. He is also considered by Yoshitsune and the protagonist as a wonderful uncle who they have a deep faith in.
